topicName: Cloud Interconnect: Dedicated and Partner Interconnect
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Cloud Interconnect: Dedicated and Partner Interconnect"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Google Cloud Interconnect provides low latency, high availability connections between your on-premises network and Google's network. This allows you to reliably transfer data between your existing infrastructure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). There are two main types of Cloud Interconnect: Dedicated Interconnect and Partner Interconnect."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Dedicated Interconnect"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Dedicated Interconnect provides a direct physical connection between your on-premises network and Google's network. You establish this connection at a Google Cloud Interconnect location. This option is ideal for organizations that require high bandwidth and low latency, and have the technical expertise to manage their own network infrastructure."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Provides a direct, physical connection to Google's network."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Offers bandwidth options of 10 Gbps or 100 Gbps."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Requires you to manage your own routing and network configuration."},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Suitable for high-bandwidth, low-latency applications."},{"order":9,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Requires a Google Cloud Router to exchange routes with your on-premises network using BGP (Border Gateway Protocol)."},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Partner Interconnect"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Partner Interconnect allows you to connect to Google's network through a supported service provider. This option is suitable for organizations that don't have the resources or expertise to manage a direct physical connection, or whose bandwidth requirements are lower. Partner Interconnect providers offer various bandwidth options and managed services."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Connects to Google's network through a supported service provider."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Offers bandwidth options ranging from 50 Mbps to 10 Gbps."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"The service provider manages the physical connection and some aspects of the network configuration."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Suitable for organizations with lower bandwidth requirements or those who prefer a managed service."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Also requires a Google Cloud Router to exchange routes with your on-premises network using BGP."},{"order":17,"type":"subheading","text":"Choosing Between Dedicated and Partner Interconnect"},{"order":18,"type":"paragraph","text":"The best choice between Dedicated and Partner Interconnect depends on your specific requirements. Consider the following factors:"},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Bandwidth requirements: Dedicated Interconnect is better for high bandwidth needs (10 Gbps or 100 Gbps), while Partner Interconnect is suitable for lower bandwidth needs (50 Mbps to 10 Gbps)."},{"order":20,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Latency requirements: Dedicated Interconnect generally offers lower latency due to the direct physical connection."},{"order":21,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Technical expertise: Dedicated Interconnect requires more technical expertise to manage the network connection."},{"order":22,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Cost: Consider the cost of the physical connection, equipment, and ongoing maintenance for Dedicated Interconnect, versus the service provider fees for Partner Interconnect."},{"order":23,"type":"subheading","text":"Setting up a Cloud Router"},{"order":24,"type":"paragraph","text":"Regardless of whether you choose Dedicated or Partner Interconnect, you'll need to configure a Cloud Router in your Google Cloud project. The Cloud Router will exchange routes with your on-premises network using BGP. Here's a basic example of how to create a Cloud Router using the gcloud CLI:"},{"order":25,"type":"code","text":"gcloud compute routers create [ROUTER_NAME] \\\n    --network=[NETWORK_NAME] \\\n    --region=[REGION]"},{"order":26,"type":"paragraph","text":"Replace [ROUTER_NAME] with the name you want to give your router, [NETWORK_NAME] with the name of your VPC network, and [REGION] with the region where you want to create the router."},{"order":27,"type":"subheading","text":"Configuring BGP Sessions"},{"order":28,"type":"paragraph","text":"After creating the Cloud Router, you'll need to configure BGP sessions to exchange routes with your on-premises network. This involves specifying the ASN (Autonomous System Number) of your on-premises network and configuring BGP peers on the Cloud Router. Consult the Google Cloud documentation for detailed instructions on configuring BGP sessions."},{"order":29,"type":"paragraph","text":"Example gcloud command to add a BGP peer:"},{"order":30,"type":"code","text":"gcloud compute routers add-bgp-peer [ROUTER_NAME] \\\n    --name=[PEER_NAME] \\\n    --peer-asn=[PEER_ASN] \\\n    --peer-ip-address=[PEER_IP_ADDRESS] \\\n    --region=[REGION] \\\n    --interface=[INTERFACE_NAME]"},{"order":31,"type":"paragraph","text":"Remember to replace the bracketed placeholders with your actual values. [ROUTER_NAME] is the name of your Cloud Router, [PEER_NAME] is the name you give to this BGP peer, [PEER_ASN] is the ASN of your on-premises network, [PEER_IP_ADDRESS] is the IP address of your on-premises router, [REGION] is the region of your Cloud Router, and [INTERFACE_NAME] is the name of the interface on your Cloud Router."},{"order":32,"type":"subheading","text":"Summary"},{"order":33,"type":"paragraph","text":"Cloud Interconnect provides robust connectivity options for extending your on-premises network to Google Cloud. Dedicated Interconnect offers high bandwidth and low latency through a direct physical connection, while Partner Interconnect provides a more flexible and managed solution through a service provider. Carefully evaluate your requirements to determine the best option for your organization."}]
